messages:
Anya (Partnerships): Quick Q — for the Q2 onramp private offers, how do we want to handle discount de-escalation vs SLA-bucket gating? Need a crisp ops checklist before partner kickoff.

Omar (Sales): I vote for a 3-step de-escalation so sellers have predictable speak: heavy up-front discount to accelerate consumption, then step down over ~6 months.

Lee (Finance): Agree on steps but prefer triggers based on committed-spend attainment not just calendar. Example: advance to next band when customer hits X% of commit in N days.

Jess (RevOps): We should also bake a renewal retention trigger — if usage drops below 50% of forecast in month 5, auto-offer a one-time top-up credit + enablement session. Prevent churn.

Priya (Product): SLA buckets tie into Dedicated vs Hosted routing. Proposal: Gold SLA (99.9%) = reserved capacity + small surcharge; Silver SLA (99.5%) = best-effort routing. Discount eligibility requires being on correct SLA for >30d.

Omar (Sales): For marketplace private offers we can express staged discounts as separate SKUs/lines with start/end dates — marketplaces (AWS/GCP) allow private terms and promo lines. Good way to encode step-down.

pricing-bot: Draft private-offer template generated: /templates/onramp-step-discount-v1.docx (owned by Jess).

Anya (Partnerships): I sketched a simple banding table to make the idea concrete — sharing here:

```
Band        | Window   | Discount | Trigger
Onramp      | 0-60d    | 30%      | sign + go-live
Adopt       | 61-150d  | 15%      | >=60% commit used in window
Sustain     | 151-365d | 10%      | renewal signed
```

Lee (Finance): Replace the calendar windows with "or attainment" checks. Finance caps max discount exposure per customer; will send cap table.

Jess (RevOps): Ops notes: marketplace private offers need exact SKU names and effective timestamps. Also decide whether discounts are refundable credits or invoice-level adjustments.

Priya (Product): Add-on: HW partner kicker — if customer purchases partner appliance SKU at time of commit, add extra 1-3% off for first 12 months. Need legal + partner consent.

Omar (Sales): Seller comms: share one-pager + 3 example deal wirings. I'll own comms and enablement deck.

Jess (RevOps): Action items: 
- Jess -> create private-offer in each marketplace (AWS/GCP) for pilot deals (ETA 5 business days)
- Omar -> seller one-pager + 3 example price points (ETA 3 business days)
- Lee -> send discount exposure caps and approved triggers (ETA 2 business days)
- Priya -> add SLA & HW kicker language for legal (ETA 4 business days)

Anya (Partnerships): Sweet. Weekly sync to validate templates and sample private-offers. Thurs 11am UTC works?

pricing-bot: Reminder set for 2024-04-04 11:00 UTC :alarm_clock:

Omar (Sales): Thx — will post draft seller script in #partnerships before the sync.

Lee (Finance): Will also include example P&L impact for a 3-yr commit with step-down schedule.

Anya (Partnerships): Great. If we can get the pilot private-offer live for 2 customers by end of month, we can iterate the step schedule vs actual consumption.

Priya (Product): Noted. I'll coordinate legal sign-off on the HW kicker clause.

Jess (RevOps): I'll link the marketplace SKU mapping once created.

Anya (Partnerships): Thanks all — filing this as the playbook draft. See you Thu 11. :rocket:
